falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows invalidates the bottom pattern match; the 77% similarity to bottom_2024_aug requires holding above that structural support, and losing it proves this was not a bottom formation but a breakdown continuation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 suggests controlled fear/peak anxiety; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic escalation rather than blowoff capitulation, meaning the current signal misread market stress as exhaustion when it was actually acceleration

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve uninverts (10Y yield exceeds 2Y yield by more than 10 basis points) and holds for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The pattern match to August 2024 bottom occurred during deep inversion; a sustained uninversion signals recession confirmation/liquidity crisis rather than soft-landing bottoming, invalidating the macro setup that generated the 77% pattern similarity

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
